purpose: Prove 100% SBOM coverage of dependency-bearing roots by discovering the denominator from the tree, including components that carry third-party imports without declaring a manifest, and by verifying every exclusion on each run instead of trusting a list.
requiredInvariants: The denominator must be discovered from the tracked tree and never hand-entered.
A component carrying third-party imports without a declared manifest must appear in the denominator, not vanish from it.
100% may only be reported when uncovered is 0 and unknown is 0; a rounded percentage must never stand in for completeness.
An exclusion is valid only while every supporting condition still holds, re-evaluated on each run.
An exclusion with no conditions, or with a failing condition, must fail closed as a fabricated justification.
Evidence must be deterministic and bound to the exact source SHA.
apps/landing must not be modified - AGENTS.md forbids it and this slice only reads its manifest.
No product business logic, dependency, lockfile, production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: A new manifest with no SBOM mapping fails closed.
A runtime component without an SBOM is never counted as covered.
A justified non-runtime exclusion is permitted and re-verified.
A false 100% with uncovered > 0 fails closed.
Two runs over the same tree produce byte-identical evidence.
Every CSV row is bound to the exact source SHA.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the seven authorized paths.
